steps.why: Android creates Android/data/io.github.hpvr.quest/files on the first launch.

steps.text: Extract the release zip on your PC, keep the headset connected, and run INSTALL.bat. Choose your Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone PC game folder when it asks. It prepares the audio and maps and copies them to the headset. Then open Harry Potter VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

otherWays.label: Harry Potter VR installer
otherWays.help: Run INSTALL.bat from HPVR-Quest-<version>.zip. It prepares the audio and maps from your PC game folder, installs the game and copies the files to the headset. qgp needs it for the game files too.

notes: INSTALL.bat converts the audio and maps (tools/hpvr_quest_prepare_assets.exe in the zip) and pushes them to files/HP/ (system/HPBase.u, system/HarryPotter.u, Maps/Lev_Tut1.unr). The converted layout is not documented in the guide, so qgp cannot push the files itself yet; the bat also sideloads the APK again. The APK in the zip is named HPVR-Quest-Demo.apk even in the full 0.1.4.1 release. Needs the US 2001 PC version.
